verdict.rationale: Oracle documents an import job to migrate existing Terraform state files into Resource Manager, showing some support for bringing pre-existing infrastructure under IaC management. However, there is no documentation of granular resource-level import (e.g., terraform import for individual resources not yet in any state), no mention of drift detection/reconciliation workflows, and no discussion of resource discovery tooling for greenfield-to-brownfield migration. Missing for 10: resource-level import workflow docs, drift detection/remediation guidance, resource discovery tooling evidence, independent corroboration of import success.
